charts.title: KELT-24 b: orbits around KELT-24
charts.description: The orbits of KELT-24's planets in this map from above, to scale, with KELT-24 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Giovinazzi et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..118G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GIOVINAZZI_ET_AL__2024): P 5.55149296 d

charts.title: KELT-24 b: its transit
charts.description: KELT-24 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (60, 74, 75) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 349827430, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 17-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 17-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
